result.requirement: The system shall automatically apply and track customer loyalty points or subscription benefits during the checkout and settlement process.
result.business_need: The business needs to incentivize repeat purchases and retain customers by seamlessly integrating loyalty rewards into the transaction flow without manual intervention.
functional_behaviour: The system shall validate the Customer Profile to determine eligibility for loyalty programs or subscription tiers before finalizing the Order Request.
The system shall calculate the applicable discount or benefit value based on the current loyalty rules and the total monetary value of the Order Request.
The system shall deduct the calculated loyalty value from the Financial Transaction Record to generate the net settlement amount due to the Store Partner.
The system shall update the Customer Profile to reflect the remaining loyalty balance or subscription status after the transaction is settled.
The system shall generate a Feedback Record entry indicating the specific loyalty benefit applied to the transaction for audit and reporting purposes.
related_information_requirements: Verified details about the ordering individual, including unique identifiers, delivery addresses, and primary contact methods
The complete record of monetary exchange, detailing item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and the net settlement amounts due to each party
The specific list of items selected by the customer, their quantities, unit prices, and any special handling notes or delivery preferences provided by the customer
business_rules: A loyalty benefit cannot be applied if the Customer Profile indicates the account is suspended or flagged for fraud.
The net settlement amount must be recalculated immediately if the applied loyalty benefit exceeds the total order value, resulting in a zero or negative charge.
The system must prevent the application of loyalty benefits if the Order Request contains items restricted by the Store Partner Agreement.
The Customer Profile must be updated within the same transaction session to ensure the deducted balance is immediately reflected.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer with an active loyalty account places an Order Request with a total value greater than their available points.
acceptance_criteria.when: The checkout process is initiated and the system processes the payment.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system applies the maximum available points as a discount, deducts the value from the Financial Transaction Record, and updates the Customer Profile with the remaining balance.

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer attempts to use loyalty points on an Order Request containing items explicitly excluded by the Store Partner Agreement.
acceptance_criteria.when: The checkout process attempts to apply the loyalty benefit.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the application of the loyalty benefit, displays an error message explaining the restriction, and proceeds with the full monetary charge without updating the Customer Profile balance.
